content.title: Channel 8 / 880
content.summary: Arvada's government access channels, Comcast and TDS channels 8 and 880, feature City Council meetings, community shows, and political forums. Residents can watch live on cable, through Apple TV and Roku apps, online streaming, or by downloading a media player playlist. Additionally, the city's YouTube channel offers a library of over 400 videos, including City Council meetings and community topics.
content.body:
Arvada's government access channels, Comcast and TDS channels 8 and 880, include City Council meetings, shows, political forums, and special features about our community.

## Ways to watch

- **Comcast or TDS cable:**watch live on channel 8 or 880 with your Comcast or TDS cable service
- **Apple TV and Roku:**download the app and search "Arvada"
- **Online:**[live stream on your internet browser using this link](http://katv.arvada.org/cablecastapi/live?channel_id=1&use_cdn=false)
- **Media player:**[download the live stream playlist](http://stream.arvada.org/live/live.m3u8) to play on your preferred media player (Windows Media Play, VLC Media Player)

If you experience problems with the streaming content, please [contact KATV Channel 8 using Ask Arvada](https://seeclickfix.com/web_portal/m96AzqbgQ9RW9z5CcqFqEwP8/issues/map).

## YouTube

Our YouTube channel includes a library of City Council meetings, over 400 videos covering many topics in the "About Arvada" section, and much more!

### [Visit our YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@cityofarvada "View the City's YouTube channel in new tab")
